## Summary

Puts translated sentences back into the original data module. The DMC stays the same and only the language changes. If the data module has changed since the sentences were taken out, it stops with `skeleton-mismatch`

## Description returned by `tools/list`

This is the text an LLM receives.

> Put translated sentences back into the data module they were taken from. The output has the same DMC with only the language changed (issueInfo too if given). It stops with error.code "skeleton-mismatch" when the data module changed since extract_segments (skeletonHash). A segment whose id is unknown, duplicated, or whose {n} placeholders do not match is not applied and is listed in unapplied[] (the original sentence stays). The result is verified. Writes only when write is true.

## Arguments

The content of `inputSchema`. A nested argument is written as `parent.child`, and an item of an array as `parent[].child`.

| Name | Type | Required | Constraints | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `path` | `string` |  |  | File path of the document. |
| `xml` | `string` |  |  | An existing document as an XML string (alternative to path; max 5 MB). Not for XML you wrote yourself: build new data modules with build_data_module. |
| `csdbDirs` | `array<string>` |  |  | CSDB folders used to resolve references, find BREX and number new objects (default: S1000D_CSDB_DIR / the config file). The FIRST folder is also where write: true writes (it may not exist yet). When given, these folders replace S1000D_CSDB_DIR and the csdbDirs of the config file (they are not added to them); other folders that do not exist are skipped and reported in _notes. |
| `skeletonHash` | `string` | Yes |  | The skeletonHash returned by extract_segments. |
| `segments` | `array<object>` | Yes |  | The translated sentences, by segment id. |
| `segments[].id` | `string` | Yes |  |  |
| `segments[].text` | `string` | Yes |  |  |
| `language` | `object` | Yes |  | Target language written to dmIdent/language. |
| `language.languageIsoCode` | `string` | Yes |  | 言語コード（例: ja） |
| `language.countryIsoCode` | `string` | Yes |  | 国コード（例: JP） |
| `issueInfo` | `object` |  |  | Issue of the translated data module (default: same as the source). |
| `issueInfo.issueNumber` | `string` | Yes | pattern `^\d{3,4}$` | 発行番号（3 桁） |
| `issueInfo.inWork` | `string` | Yes | pattern `^\d{2}$` | 作業中番号（2 桁） |
| `write` | `boolean` |  | default `false` | Write the result into the CSDB (the first folder of csdbDirs / S1000D_CSDB_DIR). Default false: the XML is only returned. Nothing is written when the XML is not valid against the XSD unless allowInvalid is true. |
| `overwrite` | `boolean` |  | default `false` | With write: true, replace a file of the same name. Default false: an existing file is left alone and reported as write-conflict. |
| `allowInvalid` | `boolean` |  | default `false` | With write: true, write even when verification.schema.state is "invalid". Default false. |
| `maxFixes` | `integer` |  | default `50`, ≥ 1, ≤ 1000 | Cap on the remaining fixes listed in the response (default 50). |
